name: renovate-reviewer
description: Local dashboard for reviewing Renovate MRs — changelog lookup, CI status, and merge verdict
author: Grace Li

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npx --prefix client vite build --config client/vite.config.ts
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --kill-others "node_modules/.bin/ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only --project server/tsconfig.json server/index.ts" "client/node_modules/.bin/vite --config client/vite.config.ts" "node_modules/.bin/wait-on tcp:8000 && node_modules/.bin/electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && electron-builder
